select aaa.* from (
UNION ALL
) aaa left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl_es on aaa.entrustStatus=sdl_es.ITEM_CODE and sdl_es.DICT_CODE='ENTRUST_STATUS' left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl_pm on aaa.priceModel=sdl_pm.ITEM_CODE and sdl_pm.DICT_CODE='PRICE_MODEL' left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl_ps on aaa.ps=sdl_ps.ITEM_CODE and sdl_ps.DICT_CODE='BACK_LEND_DIRECTION'
order by sdl_es.ORDER_NO, aaa.entrustId DESC

if.where: aaa.entrustId || '|' || aaa.entrustStatus || '|' || aaa.invManagerId || '|' || aaa.portfolioId || '|' || aaa.portfolioName || '|' || aaa.termType || '|' || aaa.repoTerm || '|' || aaa.ps || '|' || aaa.entrustAmt || '|' || priceModel || '|' || aaa.price || '|' || aaa.settleSpreed || '|' || aaa.vdate || '|' || aaa.mdate || '|' || aaa.finishAmt || '|' || aaa.transactioncom || '|' || aaa.REMARK || '|' || sdl_es.item_value || '|' || sdl_pm.item_value || '|' || sdl_ps.item_value like '%' || #{keywords} || '%'
